bjt.dhp21:4:
matā → apramādo hyamṛtapadaṃ pramādo mṛtyunaඃ padam. 
apramattā na mrīyante ye pramattāඃ sadā mṛtāඃ (udānavarga-apramādavarga v 6) 
apramadu amatapadaṃ pramadu macuno pada 
apramata na mīyati ye pramata yadha mutu. (prākṛtadharmapada)
bjt.dhp22:4:
ratā → etad viśeṣato jñatvā hyapramādasya paṇḍitaඃ 
apramāde pramodata nityamāryaඃ svagocaram. (udānavarga-apramādavarga v 10) 
eta viśeṣadha ñatva apramadasa patito 
apramadi pramodia ariana goyari rato. (prā. dha.)
bjt.dhp24:4:
yaso’bhivaḍḍhati → utthānavataඃ smṛtātmataඃ śucicittasya niśamyacāriṇaඃ 
saṃyatasya hi dharmajīvino hyapramattasya yaśo’bhivaṭhiti (udānavarga-apramādavarga v.6)
uṭhanamato smatimato suyikamasa niśamacarino 
sañata hi dhamajīvino apramatasa yaśidhavaḍhati (prā. dha. A.. 8 8)
bjt.dhp25:4:
nābhikīrati → utthānenāpramādena saṃyamena damena ca 
dvīpaṃ karoti medhāvi tamoghonābhimardatī. (udāna-apramāda. v.5) 
uṭhanena apramādena sañamena damena ca 
divu karoti medhavi ya jara nābhimardati. (prā. dha. A 8 7)
bjt.dhp26:4:
rakkhati → pramada anuyujati bala dræmedhino jana 
apramada tu medhavī dhana śeyī va rajati (prā. dha. A 4 14) 
pramādamanuvartante bālādumēdhaso janāඃ 
apramādaṃ tu medhāvī dhanaṃ śreṣṭha va rakṣate. (udānavarga-apramādavarga v. 10)
bjt.dhp27:4:
sukhaṃ → pramādaṃ nānuyujyeta na kāmaratisaṃsatavam 
apramattaඃ sadādhyāyī prāpanute paramaṃ sukhaṃ (udānavarga-(iv v. 11) 
na i pramada samayu aprati asava chayi. 
apramato hi jhayatu pranoti paramu sukhu (prā.dha.) 
apramadi pramodiya ma gāmarati samhamu 
apramato hi jhayatu viśeṣa adhigachati (prā. dha.)
bjt.dhp28:6:
avekkhati → pramādamapramādena yadā nudati paṇḍitaඃ 
prajñāprasādamāruhya tvaśokaඃ śokinīṃ prajām 
parvatastha iva bhūmiṣṭhān dhīro bālānavekṣate (udāna-apramāda. v.4) 
prajñāprasādamāruyyāśovyaඃ śocato janān 
bhūmiṣṭhāniva śailasthaඃ sarvān prājñe’nupaśyati (yogabhāṣya 1 40) 
pramada apramadena yada nudatī panītu. 
praña prasada aruyu aśoka śoino jana 
pravataṭhova bhumaṭha dhīru bala avechati. (prā. dha. A 9. 15)
bjt.dhp29:4:

abalaśa va bhadraśu hitva yatī sumedhasu.
bjt.dhp30:4:

apramādena maghavān devānaṃ śreṣṭhatāṃ gataඃ (udānavarga iv v. 24) 
apramadena makaha devana samidhi gatu. 
apramada praśajhati pramadu garahitu sada (prā. dha. A 3.17.)
bjt.dhp31:4:

durgādudadharata ātamānaṃ paṅkasatta iva kuñjaraඃ (udānavarga apramāda-12)
bjt.dhp32:4:

abhavu parihatapha nivanaseva satii. (prā. dha. B. 32)

bjt.dhp37:4:

bjt.dhp38:4:

bjt.dhp101:4:

yo caikaṃ jayedātamānaṃ sa vai saṃgrāmajīdavaraඃ (mahāvastu 3, 436 piṭa)

eka ji...... atamana so ho sagamu utamu (prā. dha. c. 6)
bjt.dhp106:6:
hutaṃ → varṣe varṣeśvamedhena yo yajate śataṃ samāඃ 
māṃsāni ca na bādedyasatayoඃ puṇyaphalaṃ samam. (manu. v. 53) 
yo yajena sahasrāṇāṃ māse māse śatāśatam 
na so buddhe prasādasya kalāmarghati ṣoḍaśim. (mahāvastu 3. 436 piṭa) 
masi masi sahasina yo yaeva śatena ca 
nevi budhi prasadasa kala aveti ṣoḍaśa. (prā. dha.)
bjt.dhp107:6:
hutaṃ → yo ca varṣaśataṃ jivedaganiṃ paricaranśacaret 
patrāhāro chamāvāsī karonto vividhaṃ tapam. 
yaśvaikaṃ bhāvitātmānaṃ muhūrtamapi pūjayet 
sa ekā pūjanā śreyo na ca varṣaśataṃ hutam (mahāvastu 3. 436 piṭa) 
ya ja vaṣa śata jatu agi pariyara vane 
........ sa pi telena diva ratra atadrita 
eka ji bhavitatmana muhūtaviva puae 
sayeva puyana ṣebha yajī vaṣa śata hotu. (prā. dha. C. 20, 21)
bjt.dhp108:4:
seyyā → yat kiṃvidiṣṭaṃ ca hutaṃ ca loke 
saṃvattaraṃ yajati puṇyaprekṣo 
sarvaṃ hi taṃ na caturbhāgameti 
abhivādanaṃ ujjugateṣu śreyami. (mahāvastu 3. 436 piṭa) 
ya kiji yiṭha va hota va loke. 
........................................................... 
........................................................... 
abhivadana ujukateṣu ṣiho (prā. dha. C. 22)
bjt.dhp109:4:
balaṃ → abhivādanaśīlasya nityaṃ vṛdedhāpasevinaඃ 
catvāri sampravarṭhante āyurvidyā yaśo balam. (manusmṛti 2.121) 
adhivadanaśilisa nica vṛḍhavasayino 
catvari tasa vardhati ayo kīrti subha bala. (prā. dha. C. 34.)
bjt.dhp110:4:
jhāyino → yo ca varṣaśataṃ jivedaduඃśīlo asamāhitaඃ 
ekāhaṃ jīvitaṃ śreyaඃ śīlavantasya dhyāyato. (mahāvastu 3. 436 piṭa)
bjt.dhp112:4:
daḷhaṃ → yo ca varṣaśataṃ jivet kuśido hīnavīryyavān 
ekāhaṃ jīvitaṃ śreyaඃ śīlavantasya dhyāyato. (mahāvastu 3. 436 piṭa) 
ya ji vaṣa śata jivi kusidhu hinaviriyava 
muhutu jīvita ṣeha viriya arahato dāḍha. (prā. dha. C 17)
bjt.dhp113:4:
udayavyayaṃ → yo ca....... apaśyaṃ udayavyayam 
....... paśyato udayavyayam. (mahāvastu 3. 436 piṭa) 
ya ji vaṣa śata jivi apaśu udakavaya 
muhuta jivita ṣehu paśato udakavaya. (prā. dha C 18)
bjt.dhp114:4:
padaṃ → yo ca....... apaśyaṃ amātaṃ padam 
......... paśyato amātaṃ padam. (mahāvastu. 3. 436 piṭa)
bjt.dhp115:4:
dhammamuttamaṃ → yo ca ......... apaśyaṃ dhammuttamam

muhuta jīvita sehu paśatu dhamu utamu. (prā. dha. G. 19)

bjt.dhp126:4: anāsavā → narakaṃ pāpakarmāṇaඃ kṛtapuṇyasatu svargatim (udānavarga v. 24)

yo’hiṃsakāni bhūtāni hinasatyātmasukhecchayā

savisu bhutesu nihai dana

bjt.dhp149:4:

sato hiva sahi pravedayiti (prā. dha. C O V 21)

suttas.title: Brāhmaṇavagga
rows: so sucī so ca brāhmaṇo. kinte

Ettāvatā sabbapaṭhame yamakavagge cuddasa vatthūni, appamādavagge nava, cittavagge nava, pupphavagge dvādasa, bālavagge pannarasa, paṇḍitavagge ekādasa, arahantavagge dasa, sahassavagge cuddasa, pāpavagge dvādasa, daṇḍavagge ekādasa, jarāvagge nava, attavagge dasa, lokavagge ekādasa, buddhavagge nava, sukhavagge aṭṭha, piyavagge nava, kodhavagge aṭṭha, malavagge dvādasa, dhammaṭṭhavagge dasa, maggavagge dvādasa, pakiṇṇakavagge nava, nirayavagge nava, nāgavagge aṭṭha, taṇhāvagge dvādasa, bhikkhuvagge dvādasa, brāhmaṇavagge cattālīsāti pañcādhikāni tīṇi vatthusatāni.

bjt.dhp383:4:
brāhmaṇa → jinḍi srotaඃ parākrāmya kāmān praṇuda 
brāhmaṇa nāprahāya muniඃ kāmān ekatvamadhigacchati. (udānavarga 10.1)
bjt.dhp386:4:
brāhmaṇaṃ → jhayi parakata budhu kitakica anasavu 
budhu daśabaluvetu tamahu bromī bramana. (prā. dha. B . 5)
bjt.dhp387:6:
tejasā → diva tavatī adivu rati ahai cadrimu 
sanadhu chatrio tavatī jhai tavati bramano 
adha sarva abhoratra budu tavati teyasa. (prā. dha.)
